blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu drivers launched a transport strike on Tuesday, September 29, despite a fuel price rollback and a newly implemented fare increase. The strike was led by the Cebu chapter of the Pagkakaisa ng mga Samahan ng mga Tsuper at Operator Nationwide (Piston), which said the measures had yet to offset rising fuel and operating costs. Fuel prices dropped nationwide on Tuesday, with diesel prices reduced by as much as ₱7.60 per liter, following three consecutive weeks of major increases.
